about: Strings for Jingle Bells' Kiểu 2 (version 2a), written by Composer's Assistant 2 hearing the Rhodes (its tune, rolling pairs and deep bass), as the user asked ("hãy thêm lớp nền vào bản 1b"): a bed from the first verse to the last chord (bars 4-68, after the 4-bar intro), laid out as Kiểu 1's strings were, the take the user chose there: the violas (two notes at a time at most) and the cellos (one) throughout, the violins (one) in the last verse, each under the tune (loosely: lay_in keeps what the model wrote); notes starting about twice a bar (horiz 1), the cellos less (horiz 0), the upper strings mostly by step (step 4).
